correspondences.notes: No BIDS 1.11.2 counterpart for streamline weights.

brainlife.desc: Per-streamline weights, one per line in streamline order, from SIFT2, COMMIT or LiFE filtering of a tractogram.
brainlife.name: neuro/streamline-weights

original.desc: A text file containing a list of streamline-weights in each line. This is intended to be used with algorithms like SIFT2, LiFE, and COMMIT that filter streamlines based on different anatomical and diffusion properties.

brainlife.readme:
For example

weights.txt
```
0.13
0.45
0.67
0.89
...
0.99
```

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.streamline-weights.json

files.desc: Text/CSV list of weights, one per streamline.

identifying_risks: Individual white matter geometry can support re-linkage as a structural fingerprint
Headers and metadata may carry subject codes or acquisition dates
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 4: participant-level processed neurodata without direct identifiers. Tier 4 conditions apply if used as a connectome fingerprint.
sharing_cautions: Share with coded subject IDs under a data use agreement
Strip free-text tags and dates from metadata before release
tier_conditions: Tier 1 only once aggregated across participants (e.g. a population atlas)
Tier 4 if used to build connectome fingerprints or predictive features

intended_use: Weighting streamline counts in structural connectome construction.
not_suitable_for: Use with any tractogram other than the one the weights were fitted to.

outputs_of.name: Compute streamline weights using COMMIT
outputs_of.purpose: COMMIT streamline weights from tractogram and DWI

outputs_of.name: Compute streamline weights using SIFT2
outputs_of.purpose: SIFT2 streamline weights from tractogram and FODs
